name: Thanks
overview: Scripture calls believers to express heartfelt thanks to God as an essential response to His enduring mercy and strength. The Psalms emphasize entering God's presence with thanksgiving and praise, recognizing His goodness and protection. The New Testament encourages continual giving of thanks in all circumstances, making requests known to God with a thankful heart through Jesus Christ. This gratitude is both an act of worship and a means of trusting God's provision and care.
